env.mode: local: both stacks on one Docker host, one Docker network

clients.name: net/http
clients.profile: none (Go's own TLS and HTTP/2; quic-go for HTTP/3)

env.netem: half the RTT and the loss on each direction (egress on eth0, ingress through ifb0); segmentation offloads (TSO, GSO, GRO) off under netem on both ends of the client's veth, so packets reach netem one MSS at most and a loss drops one segment
